name: io.github.pzalutski-pixel/godotlens
title: GodotLens
description: Godot's own view of your GDScript project: navigation, diagnostics, engine API, scene checks

environmentVariables.description: Godot language server host

environmentVariables.description: Godot language server port (the VS Code extension uses 6008)

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_DAP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Godot debug adapter host

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_DAP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Godot debug adapter port, used by the debug_* tools

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_BIN
environmentVariables.description: Godot executable, required by scene_* and project_config

environmentVariables.description: Project root; auto-detected by walking up for project.godot

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_LSP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for a single LSP response

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_DIAGNOSTICS_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to wait for diagnostics after a sync

environmentVariables.name: GODOT_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: Override Godot capability detection
